dialogues.jp: 「家に帰っても、やる事ねえんだよなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "If I go home, there's nothing much to do..."
dialogues.text: "If I go home, there's nothing much to do..."

dialogues.jp: とはいえ、帰らないわけにもいかないわけで。
dialogues.en: Then again, if I don't, there's nothing to do either.
dialogues.text: Then again, if I don't, there's nothing to do either.

dialogues.jp: 「しゃーない。かったるいから帰るか」
dialogues.en: "Blah, might as well just go home."
dialogues.text: "Blah, might as well just go home."

dialogues.jp:
自分でもどんな理屈だと思いつつ、俺は昇降口
に向かった。
dialogues.en: With nothing in mind, I head for the school entrance.
dialogues.text: With nothing in mind, I head for the school entrance.

dialogues.jp: 「んお？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp: 昇降口に出た所で、ことりを見つけた。
dialogues.en: Nearing the entrance, I see Kotori heading out through it.
dialogues.text: Nearing the entrance, I see Kotori heading out through it.

dialogues.jp:
何やら、ロッカーを覗き込んだまま、固まって
いる様子。
dialogues.en:
She had just peered into her locker, then suddenly stiffened
up and walked off.
dialogues.text:
She had just peered into her locker, then suddenly stiffened
up and walked off.

dialogues.jp: 「おーい、ことりさんや」
dialogues.en: "Heeeey, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Heeeey, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
悪戯でも見つかったようにびくっとした顔をす
ると、ずだだっと逃げ出した。
dialogues.en:
As if I was about to play a joke on her, she ran off as soon
as she saw my face.
dialogues.text:
As if I was about to play a joke on her, she ran off as soon
as she saw my face.

dialogues.jp: 「な、何だ？」
dialogues.en: "W, what?"
dialogues.text: "W, what?"

dialogues.jp: 俺が呆然としていると。
dialogues.en: My expression was one of blank surprise.
dialogues.text: My expression was one of blank surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ。朝倉じゃないか。今帰るところか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura. Going home already?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura. Going home already?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「…………いいところに来た」
dialogues.en: "......Excellent timing."
dialogues.text: "......Excellent timing."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「いいか、工藤。お前はこっちから回り込め。
　俺はあっちから回り込む。ふたりでことりを
　挟み撃ちだ」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, Kudou. You come from here, and I'd go from over
there. We'd catch Kotori in a pincer attack."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, Kudou. You come from here, and I'd go from over
there. We'd catch Kotori in a pincer attack."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お、おい、朝倉、話が見えないんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "H, hey, Asakura, what are you trying to do..."
dialogues.text: "H, hey, Asakura, what are you trying to do..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だ。俺にもまだ見えてない」
dialogues.en: "It's okay. I'm not sure myself either."
dialogues.text: "It's okay. I'm not sure myself either."

dialogues.jp:
逃げ出した理由は、逃げ出した張本人に尋ねる
以外わからない。
dialogues.en:
Only she would know the reason why she ran off like that at
the sight of me.
dialogues.text:
Only she would know the reason why she ran off like that at
the sight of me.

dialogues.jp: 「鳴かぬなら食べてしまえホトトギスって奴だ」
dialogues.en: "She's as curious as a cuckoo."
dialogues.text: "She's as curious as a cuckoo."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……ますますわけがわからないぞ？」
dialogues.en: "...I still don't understand?"
dialogues.text: "...I still don't understand?"

dialogues.jp: 首を傾げる工藤を置いて、俺は走り出した。
dialogues.en: Ignoring the confused Kudou, I walk out of the entrance.
dialogues.text: Ignoring the confused Kudou, I walk out of the entrance.

dialogues.jp: 「うお、もう校門の所に？」
dialogues.en: "Woh, she's already at the gates?"
dialogues.text: "Woh, she's already at the gates?"

dialogues.jp: 普通に追いかけたら追いつかない。
dialogues.en: A normal chase will definitely not be enough now.
dialogues.text: A normal chase will definitely not be enough now.

dialogues.jp: 「工藤！　作戦通りに行くぞ！」
dialogues.en: "Kudou! The operation begins now!"
dialogues.text: "Kudou! The operation begins now!"

dialogues.jp: 追いかけてきている工藤に声をかける。
dialogues.en: I yelled at him as I ran off in pursuit.
dialogues.text: I yelled at him as I ran off in pursuit.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ああ。とにかくことりを捕まえればいい
　んだよな？」
dialogues.en: "O, okay. We just have to catch Kotori, right?"
dialogues.text: "O, okay. We just have to catch Kotori, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そうだ！」
dialogues.en: "Yes!"
dialogues.text: "Yes!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は近道をした。
dialogues.en: I managed to take a shortcut.
dialogues.text: I managed to take a shortcut.

dialogues.jp: 「追いつい……たっ！」
dialogues.en: "I've got you.. now!"
dialogues.text: "I've got you.. now!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Wah?!"
dialogues.text: "Wah?!"

dialogues.jp:
突如ことりの前に出現した俺に、ことりの足が
止まる。
dialogues.en:
Jumping in front of her suddenly, Kotori stopped in her
tracks.
dialogues.text:
Jumping in front of her suddenly, Kotori stopped in her
tracks.

dialogues.jp: 慌てて反対方向を向くが──。
dialogues.en: And right after me, from behind Kotori, came--
dialogues.text: And right after me, from behind Kotori, came--

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……はぁ……はぁ、ことりって、足、速
　いんだね？」
dialogues.en:
"Haah... Haah... Haah, Kotori, you run pretty... Haah...
fast..."
dialogues.text:
"Haah... Haah... Haah, Kotori, you run pretty... Haah...
fast..."

dialogues.jp: 工藤が息を切らしながら立っていた。
dialogues.en: Kudou bended forward slightly, breathless.
dialogues.text: Kudou bended forward slightly, breathless.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんで──」
dialogues.en: "Why--"
dialogues.text: "Why--"

dialogues.jp:
全て言い切る前に、胸に抱えていた何か──色
とりどりの紙封筒──を地面に落とした。
dialogues.en:
Before she could say anything else, something she was
holding close to her chest --a multi-coloured envolope--
dropped to the ground.
dialogues.text:
Before she could say anything else, something she was
holding close to her chest --a multi-coloured envolope--
dropped to the ground.

dialogues.jp: 「あっ……悪い」
dialogues.en: "Ah... sorry."
dialogues.text: "Ah... sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だ、駄目っ！」
dialogues.en: "D, Don't!"
dialogues.text: "D, Don't!"

dialogues.jp:
拾おうとしてしゃがんだところで、頭上から声
が振ってきた。
dialogues.en:
Just as I started bending downwards to pick it up, her voice
shrieked out from above my head.
dialogues.text:
Just as I started bending downwards to pick it up, her voice
shrieked out from above my head.

dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
ふわっと、風が吹き付けてきた。ことりが凄い
勢いでしゃがみ込んだのだ。
dialogues.en:
A gust of wind suddenly blew past. With surprising agility,
Kotori squatted down and grabbed the flapping letter in
mid-flight.
dialogues.text:
A gust of wind suddenly blew past. With surprising agility,
Kotori squatted down and grabbed the flapping letter in
mid-flight.

dialogues.jp:
鞄の中に封筒を｛か／掻｝き入れていくその姿に、ふと、
とある光景を思い出した。
dialogues.en:
she quickly threw the envelope back into a bag. I caught a
glimpse inside, and would do well to forget it.
dialogues.text:
she quickly threw the envelope back into a bag. I caught a
glimpse inside, and would do well to forget it.

dialogues.jp:
電車の中、紙袋から大量の同人誌をこぼしてし
まい、真っ赤になりながら回収していた青年…。
dialogues.en:
It was a bag full of envelopes, about the size of a garbage
bag.
dialogues.text:
It was a bag full of envelopes, about the size of a garbage
bag.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あはは……」
dialogues.en: "A, ahaha..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……恥ずかしいポエムでも書きつづったブツ
　なのか？」
dialogues.en: "...A bunch of embarassing poems inside, I bet?"
dialogues.text: "...A bunch of embarassing poems inside, I bet?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、それは違うだろ」
dialogues.en: "...A bit wrong I think, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "...A bit wrong I think, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜も〜、分かっているくせに、そういう事
　言うんですよね」
dialogues.en: "Ah~ Geez~, you know already, don't tease me like that..."
dialogues.text: "Ah~ Geez~, you know already, don't tease me like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "So that's what it is."
dialogues.text: "So that's what it is."

dialogues.jp: 色とりどりの紙封筒──ラブレターってわけだ。
dialogues.en:
The colourful envelopes-- they definitely housed love
letters.
dialogues.text:
The colourful envelopes-- they definitely housed love
letters.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりってもてるんだな」
dialogues.en: "You're really popular, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "You're really popular, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もてる女はツライですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's painful for a girl to be popular."
dialogues.text: "It's painful for a girl to be popular."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もてない男よりはツラクはないだろ」
dialogues.en: "You obviously haven't been an unpopular guy."
dialogues.text: "You obviously haven't been an unpopular guy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君って、結構素敵だと思いますよ」
dialogues.en: "That's not true, I think you are!"
dialogues.text: "That's not true, I think you are!"

dialogues.jp: ことりがくるりと背後を振り返る。
dialogues.en: Kotori turned her head to face behind her.
dialogues.text: Kotori turned her head to face behind her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ねっ？　工藤君？」
dialogues.en: "Right, Kudou-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Right, Kudou-kun?"

dialogues.jp:
急にふられた工藤は面食らったような表情を見
せていたが、すぐに余裕を取り戻して、にっこ
り笑った。
dialogues.en:
Kudou was taken aback for a second, but quickly regained his
composure and returned a willing smile.
dialogues.text:
Kudou was taken aback for a second, but quickly regained his
composure and returned a willing smile.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Right, of course!"
dialogues.text: "Right, of course!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……お前に誉められて、俺は喜ぶべきなの
　か？」
dialogues.en: "...Should I be happy at your compliments?"
dialogues.text: "...Should I be happy at your compliments?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「喜ぶべきですよ。ね？　工藤君？」
dialogues.en: "Of course you should, right, Kudou-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Of course you should, right, Kudou-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ああ。そうだな。喜んでくれたら、嬉し
　いぞ」
dialogues.en:
"A, ahh, of course. I'd be glad to make someone else happy
as well!"
dialogues.text:
"A, ahh, of course. I'd be glad to make someone else happy
as well!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……んじゃまぁ、一応喜んでおくか」
dialogues.en: "...In that case, I guess I am, thanks."
dialogues.text: "...In that case, I guess I am, thanks."

dialogues.jp:
だけど、実際のところ、学園一の美男美女に誉
められても、ちっとも誉められた気がしないん
だよなぁ。
dialogues.en:
Then again, being complimented by the school's number one
good looking girl and guy, doesn't really make me feel
comforted.
dialogues.text:
Then again, being complimented by the school's number one
good looking girl and guy, doesn't really make me feel
comforted.

dialogues.jp: 目の前に確実に俺以上の存在がいるわけで。
dialogues.en:
Just looking at the pair in front of me was already enough
evidence against it.
dialogues.text:
Just looking at the pair in front of me was already enough
evidence against it.

dialogues.jp:
「……で、そのラブレターだけど。どうするん
　だ？」
dialogues.en:
"...Anyway, what are you going to do with those love
letters?
dialogues.text:
"...Anyway, what are you going to do with those love
letters?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。みんな、ごめんなさい、ですね。
　だから、ご安心を」
dialogues.en:
"That's right... I'd probably just answer "I'm sorry" to all
of them or something. So don't worry."
dialogues.text:
"That's right... I'd probably just answer "I'm sorry" to all
of them or something. So don't worry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何だよ、安心って」
dialogues.en: "W, what do you mean, me, worry?"
dialogues.text: "W, what do you mean, me, worry?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何となく、そんな気がしたんですよ」
dialogues.en: "I mean, you seem pretty concerned about it..."
dialogues.text: "I mean, you seem pretty concerned about it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Really?"
dialogues.text: "...Really?"

dialogues.jp:
思わず、頬を揉んでしまう。変な表情でもして
たかな？
dialogues.en:
I unconciously started to blush. Did my face give anything
away?
dialogues.text:
I unconciously started to blush. Did my face give anything
away?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、恋愛って真面目にしたいじゃない
　ですか」
dialogues.en:
"And in the end, I don't think the senders are serious about
their love..."
dialogues.text:
"And in the end, I don't think the senders are serious about
their love..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　まあ、そりゃ、な」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Well, really?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Well, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だから、お断りするんですよね」
dialogues.en: "So I'd reject it."
dialogues.text: "So I'd reject it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ラブレター送ってくる連中は、真面目じゃな
　いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't sending a love letter pretty serious as is?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't sending a love letter pretty serious as is?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……その人達が真面目じゃないって言うつも
　りはないんです。ただ……」
dialogues.en: "...I'm not saying that they aren't being serious. But..."
dialogues.text: "...I'm not saying that they aren't being serious. But..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ただ？」
dialogues.en: "But?"
dialogues.text: "But?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……私、あまり手紙とかって好きになれない
　んですよね」
dialogues.en:
"...I don't think it's possible to express love through a
letter."
dialogues.text:
"...I don't think it's possible to express love through a
letter."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何で……って聞いていいか？」
dialogues.en: "Why... you'd rather hear it?"
dialogues.text: "Why... you'd rather hear it?"

dialogues.jp: ことりがこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Kotori nodded her head slightly.
dialogues.text: Kotori nodded her head slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……文字だけじゃ、相手のほんとの気持ちな
　んて、分からないじゃないですか……」
dialogues.en:
"...From just words, you can't really tell the person's true
feelings..."
dialogues.text:
"...From just words, you can't really tell the person's true
feelings..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「不安なんですよね、それって……」
dialogues.en: "It's so uneasy that way, I feel..."
dialogues.text: "It's so uneasy that way, I feel..."

dialogues.jp:
唇をきゅっと噛みしめ、ことりは俯いてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en: Kotori had her head bowed slightly, chewing on her lip.
dialogues.text: Kotori had her head bowed slightly, chewing on her lip.

dialogues.jp: と、その顔がぱっと上がる。
dialogues.en: Then, she quickly lifted it back up.
dialogues.text: Then, she quickly lifted it back up.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ご、ごめんなさい、何だか、変な事言っちゃ
　いましたね」
dialogues.en: "I, I'm so sorry... I just started saying weird things..."
dialogues.text: "I, I'm so sorry... I just started saying weird things..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いやあ、別に。むしろ、参考になったくらい
　で」
dialogues.en:
"No, it's nothing. It's for the better anyway, now I have
something to reference."
dialogues.text:
"No, it's nothing. It's for the better anyway, now I have
something to reference."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「わ、私につられたんですか？　何か、変な事
　言ってましたよ、今」
dialogues.en:
"Y, you don't mean what I think you do, do you? Don't say
such weird things..."
dialogues.text:
"Y, you don't mean what I think you do, do you? Don't say
such weird things..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、どうだろ……。ま、心にはとどめて
　おくって事で」
dialogues.en: "Hm, how to put it... perhaps, a heartstopping matter?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, how to put it... perhaps, a heartstopping matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それじゃ、帰ります。バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "W, well, I'm heading back. Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "W, well, I'm heading back. Bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ……って」
dialogues.en: "Bye...bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye...bye."

dialogues.jp: 言った時にはもう消えている……。
dialogues.en: Before I could even finish my farewell, she had disappeared.
dialogues.text: Before I could even finish my farewell, she had disappeared.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「行っちゃったな……」
dialogues.en: "She escaped..."
dialogues.text: "She escaped..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ラブレター、か……」
dialogues.en: "Love letter, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Love letter, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……どうしたんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "...What about that?"
dialogues.text: "...What about that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に」
dialogues.en: "No, nothing."
dialogues.text: "No, nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「さよか」
dialogues.en: "Whatever."
dialogues.text: "Whatever."

dialogues.jp:
どうせこいつも腐るほどもらって困ってるとか
何とか、そう言うことだろう。
dialogues.en:
Despite getting all those declarions of love, she hasn't
seemed to take up any of them...
dialogues.text:
Despite getting all those declarions of love, she hasn't
seemed to take up any of them...

dialogues.jp:
もしくは、本当にもらいたい相手からはもらえ
てない、とか？
dialogues.en:
Maybe being popular, and having so many suitors, isn't as
much of an easy road as it seems?
dialogues.text:
Maybe being popular, and having so many suitors, isn't as
much of an easy road as it seems?

dialogues.jp: あり得ねえ。
dialogues.en: No use thinking about it now.
dialogues.text: No use thinking about it now.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は帰るぞ」
dialogues.en: "I'm heading home."
dialogues.text: "I'm heading home."

dialogues.jp:
「別に腹が立ったわけでも、虚しくなったわけ
　でもないからなっ」
dialogues.en: "My stomach's grumbling, I need to go fill it."
dialogues.text: "My stomach's grumbling, I need to go fill it."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.jp: 呆然とする工藤を置いて、俺は家路についた。
dialogues.en: Leaving the dumbfounded Kudou, I head back towards home.
dialogues.text: Leaving the dumbfounded Kudou, I head back towards home.

dialogues.jp:
こんなところで、現実の不平等さを目の当たり
にするとは……。
dialogues.en: This has shown me just how unfair the world is.
dialogues.text: This has shown me just how unfair the world is.

dialogues.jp: 今日の夜、俺の枕は涙に濡れてるぜ。
dialogues.en: Tonight, I'm going to cry into my pillow.
dialogues.text: Tonight, I'm going to cry into my pillow.

dialogues.jp: ◆ラブレターがたくさん◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Bagful of Love Letters◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Bagful of Love Letters◆

dialogues.jp:
帰る途中、昇降口の所でことりを見かけた。声
を掛けると、どうしてか逃げ出してしまう。
dialogues.en:
As I was heading home, I saw Kotori at the school building's
entrance. When I called to her though, she ran off
immediately.
dialogues.text:
As I was heading home, I saw Kotori at the school building's
entrance. When I called to her though, she ran off
immediately.

dialogues.jp:
帰宅途中だった工藤を捕まえて、俺達は後を追っ
た。
dialogues.en: Coercing Kudou into assistance, we ran off in hot pursuit.
dialogues.text: Coercing Kudou into assistance, we ran off in hot pursuit.

dialogues.jp: 挟み込むようにして追いつき、事情を｛き／訊｝く。
dialogues.en:
We maanged to chase her down, and got the entire matter out
of her.
dialogues.text:
We maanged to chase her down, and got the entire matter out
of her.

dialogues.jp:
どうやらことりは、ラブレターをもらったとこ
ろを見られたくなかったらしい。
dialogues.en:
It was completely unsurprising to be honest. Kotori was
exactly the type I'd imagine to receive so many love
letters.
dialogues.text:
